title: BookPage: "Add to my picks" button wired to the picks store
goal: Add the "Add to my picks" button to the book page. Use addPick from the picks store (features/picks/store/picksStore.ts) and the Button component (library/components/Button.tsx). The page needs 'use client' and React state for the status message.
spec:
BK-2: An available book has an "Add to my picks" button; pressing it adds the book to the member's picks and a status message says "Added to your picks".

BK-3: A book that is on loan says "On loan" and cannot be picked (no "Add to my picks" button, or a disabled one).
